text: please can someone get back to me I'm really scared and I don't know if I'm overreacting. I'm a foster carer and Lily, she's 4, has had runny poos since yesterday, about 4 or 5 today. She is drinking well though, juice and water, and she's weeing normally, nappy-free and going to the toilet like usual. Her skin and lips look their normal colour. She did come in from the garden this afternoon with bright red cheeks after running about in that freezing wind, but they've calmed right down now she's warm inside, same as my own kids' faces used to go. I just don't know how long the runny poo can go on before I need to worry, and I have to report anything to the social worker so I want to get it right
